summary.headline: Friday weekly book migrated from 7775 into 7800-7805; 7825 is the next upside decision.
key_points: 7750 and 7775 were reclaimed/absorbed and now behave more like lower support inventory than active upside caps.
Thursday near-spot flow was +$1.025m net calls and -$1.761m net puts; OTM flow was +$1.283m net calls and -$1.248m net puts.
The 7800-7825 Thursday zone carried about $25.2m gross premium with +$3.339m net calls and -$1.167m net puts.
Downside protection from 7740, 7700 and 7660-7675 remains in the cumulative Friday book, but it was not pulled materially upward with the rally.
The strongest near-spot put-selling conclusion is sensitive to a single 750-lot 7800P block: excluding it, near-spot puts are approximately +$0.239m net bought.
summary.daily_note: Constructive while 7800-7805 is accepted. 7825 is the upper decision; failure below 7800 reopens 7775 -> 7750 -> 7740. Structural downside instability remains below 7685.

leave_one_out.comment: Removing the largest visible print (BUY CALL 7655, 150 contracts) does not change aggregate signs; multileg and ITM context still matters.
